ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patch located on the distal third of the left lobe. Multiple discrete, circular high-intensity focal spots (approx. 5-15 pixels) scattered across the medial and proximal dark regions. Dense high-intensity clusters concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate 38-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe cord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge, with peak-to-valley heights ranging from 2-8 pixels. The right lobe edge exhibits similar serration, though partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of the left lobe, transitioning to a sharp concave sweep as it approaches the median notch; distal tips show rounded geometric termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast circular clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple isolated circular white-ring scars (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the central-left black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four prominent, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) oriented diagonally across the white distal patch of the left lobe. Several shorter, vertical linear interruptions near the central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes, resulting in irregular structural protrusions. Distinctive dark-pigmented scarring within the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple circular 'halo' marks on the dark ventral surface, indicating legacy attachment sites of ectoparasites or barnacles.
